vision: One question when a request has no outcome or boundary, and idle harness sessions do not inject the context package.

tasks.name: Sourced brief of how agents should be guided
tasks.scope: Includes a sourced brief on rules, skills, hooks, when to clarify before acting, and the token cost of long agent loops, limited to Cursor official guidance plus a few well-known agent-harness repos, articles, and talks. Excludes library edits and an unbounded survey of every agent framework.

tasks.name: Gap assessment of this library against that evidence
tasks.scope: Includes judging rules, skills, hooks, agents, and the harness process on over-specificity, asking too little before acting, and token waste from long back-and-forth, with a clear keep, change, or undecided reading. Excludes rewriting those artifacts and treating gaps as approval to implement.

tasks.name: Prioritized change plan with a do-not-change set
tasks.scope: Includes what to change, what to leave, and what not to do, sequenced for a later harness cycle, plus a reconciliation of earlier better questions versus chatty clarification. Excludes rule, skill, and hook edits, deleting skills, syncing the deployed catalog, and commits.
